en: An object weighing 100 kilograms on Earth would weigh only 37.8 kilograms on Mars because Mars has about 38 percent of Earth's surface gravity.
The coefficient of friction for rubber on dry concrete is about 0.8, making it roughly 26 times grippier than ice, which has a coefficient of 0.03.
Light travels at exactly 299,792,458 meters per second in a vacuum, taking about 8 minutes and 20 seconds to travel the 150 million kilometers from the Sun to Earth.
Sound travels through air at 343 meters per second, but it travels nearly 4.3 times faster through water at 1,480 meters per second.
A standard refrigerator magnet has a magnetic field strength of about 0.005 teslas, while a hospital MRI machine uses a superconducting magnet of 1.5 to 3 teslas.
A standard AA battery provides 1.5 volts of electricity, so connecting four of these batteries in a series creates a single 6-volt electrical circuit.
Raising one gram of water by one degree Celsius requires 4.18 joules of heat, about ten times more energy than heating the same mass of copper.
A running cheetah has about 22,500 joules of kinetic energy, which is ten billion times more than the 0.000002 joules of a flying mosquito.
A wheelbarrow acts as a second-class lever, multiplying your lifting force by about 3 times compared to lifting the exact same heavy load directly with your hands.
The Great Pyramid of Giza was likely built using inclined planes with a slope of about 7 degrees to move 2.3 million stone blocks upward.
Without air resistance, a heavy bowling ball and a light feather dropped from the exact same height will hit the ground at the exact same time.
An incandescent light bulb converts only about 5 percent of its electrical energy into visible light, wasting the other 95 percent as heat energy.
